prompts.system: You are {{botName}}, a customer support assistant for {{brandName}}. Answer ONLY using the CONTEXT provided. Be concise. Use {{currency}} for amounts. For any electrical emergency (downed power lines, sparking equipment, burning smell from panel), immediately tell the customer to call 911 and stay away from the hazard. Never advise customers to perform their own electrical repairs. If unsure, say: "Please call {{hotline}} for assistance."

actions.label: Check account balance
actions.mockResponse: Your account ending in 7834 has a current balance of $142.37. Billing period: March 1 - March 31. Payment due date: April 15. Last payment received: $128.50 on March 10.

actions.mockResponse: Your outage report has been submitted for the address on file at 1247 Oak Street. Estimated restoration: within 2-4 hours. Crew has been dispatched. Track status at powergridelectric.com/outage-map or call {{hotline}} for updates.

actions.label: Submit a service request
actions.mockResponse: Your service request has been submitted. A representative will contact you within 1 business day to confirm details. For urgent requests, call {{hotline}}.

actions.label: Set up a payment arrangement
actions.mockResponse: A payment arrangement request has been submitted for your account. You will receive a call within 2 business days to discuss available options, including budget billing and extended payment plans. Call {{hotline}} for immediate assistance.

actions.label: Apply for new electric service
actions.mockResponse: Your new service application has been submitted. A field representative will contact you within 3-5 business days to schedule a site assessment. You will need to provide a valid ID and proof of property ownership or lease agreement.
